description: Step 5 of docs/the-delivery-loop.md: an independent review of one immutable commit. The mandate is one JSON object naming the repo, the branch and the mandate file the work was done under, with base optional. The branch head is recorded and pinned under refs/sailor/reviews before anyone reads a line, together with the digests of the mandate and of docs/gates.md at that commit. The reviewer is handed a separate, locked checkout of exactly that commit and no author conversation. The verdict must name the pinned commit, say clean or findings, and list what it checked; it is written to the reviewed-commits collection keyed by branch and commit, which is what integrate-on-the-trunk reads. A branch that moves afterwards does not move the verdict: integration refuses a head that differs from the reviewed one.

with.command:
set -eu
head=$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse --verify "refs/heads/$BRANCH^{commit}") || { echo "the branch $BRANCH does not exist in this tree" >&2; exit 1; }
base=$(git -C "$REPO" merge-base "$BASE" "$head") || { echo "$BRANCH shares no history with $BASE" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -r "$MANDATE_FILE" ] || { echo "the mandate file $MANDATE_FILE cannot be read" >&2; exit 1; }
mandate_digest=$(shasum -a 256 < "$MANDATE_FILE" | awk '{ print $1 }')
gates_digest=$(git -C "$REPO" show "$head:docs/gates.md" 2>/dev/null | shasum -a 256 | awk '{ print $1 }')
pin="refs/sailor/reviews/$BRANCH/$head"
if pinned=$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse --verify --quiet "$pin"); then
    [ "$pinned" = "$head" ] || { echo "$pin already points at $pinned" >&2; exit 1; }
else
    git -C "$REPO" update-ref "$pin" "$head" ""
fi
printf '{"head":"%s","base_commit":"%s","mandate_digest":"%s","gates_digest":"%s","pin":"%s","pinned_at":%s}' \
    "$head" "$base" "$mandate_digest" "$gates_digest" "$pin" "$(date +%s)"

set -eu
short=$(printf '%s' "$HEAD_COMMIT" | cut -c1-12)
tree="$(dirname "$REPO")/$(basename "$REPO")-worktrees/review-$short"
if [ -e "$tree" ]; then
    at=$(git -C "$tree" rev-parse HEAD) || { echo "$tree exists and is not a checkout" >&2; exit 1; }
    [ "$at" = "$HEAD_COMMIT" ] || { echo "$tree stands at $at, not the pinned $HEAD_COMMIT" >&2; exit 1; }
    [ -z "$(git -C "$tree" status --porcelain)" ] || { echo "$tree carries changes: it is not the pinned commit any more" >&2; exit 1; }
else
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$tree")"
    git -C "$REPO" worktree add --detach --lock --reason "review of $HEAD_COMMIT" "$tree" "$HEAD_COMMIT" >&2
fi
at=$(git -C "$tree" rev-parse HEAD)
[ "$at" = "$HEAD_COMMIT" ] || { echo "the reviewer tree stands at $at, not $HEAD_COMMIT" >&2; exit 1; }
printf '{"tree":"%s","head":"%s"}' "$tree" "$at"

$join: , which stands at exactly that commit; never in the author's tree and never from the author's conversation. Read the mandate at
), the diff from the base, the callers the change affects, the written contracts it touches and the defaults it relies on; rerun the gates of docs/gates.md that apply (manifest sha256

). Close with sailor step approve and an output file holding one JSON object: {"commit": the commit above, "verdict": "clean" or "findings", "findings": [each finding as text], "checked": [each contract checked], "uncertainty": what you could not establish}. Reject only when the commit cannot be reviewed at all, saying why.

options.label: clean
options.facts: nothing found that stops integration, with what was checked listed

options.label: findings
options.facts: each finding written so a fix can be linked to it

with.command:
set -eu
git -C "$REPO" worktree unlock "$TREE" 2>/dev/null || true
git -C "$REPO" worktree remove "$TREE"
